current_policy_reproduction: exact row-level match to canonical verifier outcomes

policy_definitions.A_unanimous_three_source: three-source unanimity; require three registered components

policy_definitions.C_required_role_two_component: at least two supporting sources; require language plus a physical role and two registered components
